title: 目標達成の後に・挑めカワイイの冠

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan hosts a holiday meetup with her fans, Seeing the great turnout, Curren Chan really starts to feel her popularity increasing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, on the way home, we see people raving about the runner who won this year's Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She realizes again that running well is the best way to show off her cuteness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Striving for the Triple Tiara, Curren Chan aims for the Fillies' Revue next, a race that's a little longer than the distance she's best at.
